title: Scripture Metric1 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=scripture:metric1
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for scripture metric1 (1) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate scripture metric1 (1) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back how your scripture metric1 (1) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
